# Dr. Mogal Prasad Shah — Livestock Development Expert

> Portfolio and knowledge resource for Dr. Mogal Prasad Shah, M.Sc. Animal
> Nutrition, former Director of Nepal's Directorate of Livestock and
> Fisheries Development (DLFD), with 29+ years in livestock development,
> food security, and climate-resilient agriculture in Nepal. Bilingual
> (English/Nepali) content throughout.

## Key pages

- [About](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/about): Biography, education, and career history
- [Expertise & Services](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/services): Consulting service offerings — livestock development, animal health, food security, climate-resilient agriculture
- [Experience](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/experience): Career timeline across institutions
- [Publications](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/publications): Research and publications
- [Farm Tools](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/tools): 25 free bilingual farm tools in a searchable directory — each tool has its own page (/tools/weight, /tools/dosage, …): weight estimator, gestation planner, estrus & breeding planner, feed rations, dosage checks, water needs, market value, BCS guide, dairy income, land-unit converter, poultry FCR, hatchery calendar, vaccination reminders, herd & milk ledger, manure & compost value calculator (NPK, fertiliser-bag value, biogas), live weather with THI heat-stress alerts, 30-year climate tracker, methane/carbon hoofprint (IPCC Tier 1), milk fat/SNF payment, silage pit planner, calf colostrum & milk schedule, CMT udder checker, herd fodder budget, grain-storage aflatoxin risk, symptom checker — client-side, no data collected
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/knowledge): 46 sourced articles on animal health, cattle/buffalo, goats, poultry, crops, fodder, climate, farm management and pigs/fish — every figure cited (MoALD, DLS, NARC, FAO, Merck Veterinary Manual)
- [Farming Calendar](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/calendar): the Nepal crop & livestock year month by month for Terai, mid-hills and high hills — sowing and harvest windows, vaccination rounds, Dashain khasi finishing, fodder planting and fish-pond cycles
- [Nepal Agriculture Map](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/agromap): Interactive 77-district agricultural data explorer with ecological-belt, crop, livestock and climate layers, district comparison and CSV export
- [Book a Consultation](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/booking): Advisory session booking
- [Contact](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/contact): Consulting inquiries, office hours, WhatsApp and phone
